text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day off, I accompany Yaeno Muteki to visit her hometown at her invitation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I want to run unrestrained, with all my fiery emotions unleashed, there is something I have to do first.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've avoided it for so long, but I must come face-to-face with myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why am I filled with such violent fury that sends me into uncontrollable rages?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To find the answer, I must reflect upon and uncover my very essence.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To accomplish this, I've decided to revisit my Kongo Yaegaki training in order to face my past.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Ah, we've arrived. Come, it's time to take a stroll down memory lane.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We get off the train and go deeper into the mountains. She tells me we're heading to the place where students of the dojo meditate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we traverse the mountain path, Yaeno Muteki begins opening up to me about her troubles.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I've shied away from confronting myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was loath to do so, for the act would require me to scrutinize my own ugly flaws.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Where did the shameful desire to force everyone to do my bidding come from?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And what if I manage to trace that shamefulness back to its source, only to find I've got nothing inside but ugliness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Those kinds of thoughts have made me fearful of facing myself.
choice_data_list: You know you don't have to do this, right?
You know you don't have to do this, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. I do.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must! Even if I'm scared, I want to press on. I'm choosing to walk down this path, so I may gain the skills I need to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must, for the sake of creating a racing generation spearheaded by me and my dear rivals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki imbues her every word with intense determination, as if using them to cast away her doubts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is where those who practice the Kongo Yaegaki style come to meditate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki dons her signature racewear to compose herself in both mind and body for the equilibrium required in meditation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall now face myself and ascertain who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that meditating side-by-side might help us become attuned to one another, just like when we performed katas together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm! That would be very much appreciated. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let's begin…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why is it that I wish to avoid being ruled by my emotions? Why do I feel such reluctance to behave as I used to?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (The answer is simple. Nobody desires to be around that foolish version of me.)

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Shut up, shut up, shut up! You're just a weakling! Don't you talk back to me!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: If you think you're so good, then show me what you got! Whoever wins is the boss!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ugh! You're unbelievable! Go away already!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! …I hate you, Yaeno! You're too scary!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Some kids buckled under my aggressive behavior, but everyone was afraid of me… and detested me.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And of course they did. Who in their right mind would embrace a conceited tyrant who uses force to twist logic to their own liking?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I knew my actions weren't just. Yet, despite knowing it was wrong, I couldn't help but be the way I was.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I hadn't bent them to my will with force, no one would have accepted me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was always irritated and quick to anger. It was only natural people hated me… But I didn't want to be despised.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So I used my strength to overpower them. I made them accept me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be accepted… I didn't want to be hated…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even though I was just a foolish nobody prone to violent tendencies, I wished for others to really see me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There it is at the heart of my violent behavior. The essence of my raging emotions is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A wretched, intense desire for acknowledgement—for praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Containing my fiery emotions means suppressing that desire. If I don't wish to be praised, then I won't act so violently.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Once I began to repress my emotions and refrained from resorting to violence, everybody stopped hating me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even someone like me was able to gain acceptance. Once I ceased being a puppet of my emotions, people let me in.
But is that true?
Am I really no longer at the whim of my emotions? Can I really say I'm in control of my desire for approval?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Am I…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Am I being controlled by my hunger for praise even now?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I seethe over how beloved Oguri is and her status as the star of our generation! I rage for acknowledgement! I scream for people to look at me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In reality, my desire to overturn the public's opinion is just me wanting to make everyone accept that I'm the star!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nothing about me has changed! I haven't grown at all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even now, I am simply a marionette dangling from the strings of my selfish need for approval!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm… a failure.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I act on my instincts and run with my emotions laid bare…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will only become that petty tyrant I used to be…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll fly into petty rages and use my strength to strong-arm others… I'll flaunt my power, howl for praise, and demand that no one hate me…
choice_data_list: And what's so bad about that?
And what's so bad about that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I echo her words and tell her she should let her temper fly and overwhelm others with her strength and flaunt her power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I continue, asking if the strength she wishes to rely on is the same coercive strength as before.
choice_data_list: Or is it the strength of your legs, which churn up the very earth with your every step?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The core of Yaeno Muteki's being has never changed. She's always had that overwhelming desire for acknowledgement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the past, she merely wished to be praised. And if violence could prove she was superior to others, then so be it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's no longer true. She's thrown herself into the world of racing and learned how to divert her strength to the track through the Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then she met rivals who strove to outdo one another and push each other to be better—invaluable friends who brave this era of competition together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then came a number of adversaries—fellow racers who each had their own strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And of course, there's the racer who kindles her competitive fire—the one she wishes to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Competing against them has directed Yaeno Muteki's desire for approval to the domain of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If so, then what's wrong with her setting her heart ablaze, using strength to claim first and make others yield to her?
choice_data_list: Isn't that what racing is all about?
Isn't that what racing is all about?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: People… really won't hate me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even if I run with all my emotions out for the world to see?
choice_data_list: Do you really think they'll hate you after seeing how determined you are?
Do you really think they'll hate you after seeing how determined you are?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You always seem so relaxed during races, Yaeno. Are you really giving it all you've got?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You were holding back, weren't you? I bet you coulda gone harder!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I feel like I've gotten a little closer to knowing the real you. I like it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You never stopped racing. It's as if you've been running in defiance of Oguri and the others—as if to challenge the world.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The sight of you running true to your style, even amidst all the cheering for Oguri… It gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone I've competed against…
choice_data_list: They all accept you for who you are. You'll be okay.
They all accept you for who you are. You'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …You're right.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: They all recognize their opponents' strength… I've fought alongside them while we've pushed each other toward greater heights…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they've long been aware that my hunger for victory is driven by my desire for praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And that I race wildly according to my emotions…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like to follow my heart and take on the autumn Tenno Sho without suppressing my emotions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Although I can't set my fears completely to rest… I believe in everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I believe they will accept the path that I have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An intense blaze shines in Yaeno Muteki's eyes, one that burns with the tumultuous passions deep inside her.
